product.olivetti-snx-160-rs.summary: The high-availability Systema 160 that moved from Eagle to Olimpus under the same name.
product.olivetti-snx-160-rs.history: Olivetti announced the SNX 160/RS in March 1995. In April it replaced the SNX 140/R and 160/R, and the Olimpus revision retained its name.
product.olivetti-snx-160-rs.architecture: The board identifies the revision. Eagle uses the BA2155 and has documented Narrow and Wide SCSI cases. Olimpus uses the BA2298 with Wide SCSI and up to 512 MB of ECC memory.
product.olivetti-snx-160-rs.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-snx-160-rs.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
